**Summary.** All three defects I raised on candidate-03 are genuinely fixed in source, not merely annotated, and each has a regression that would fail against the old code. The strongest of the three is SIG-INDEX: the reversed-signature/two-owner fixture is precisely the case the old `.some()` predicate accepted. RUNTIME-PIN's negative controls run through a test-only entry point rather than `createFinancialComparator`, which is a real but acceptable limitation — the predicate under test is the same function the production path calls, and the positive direction is now covered by every comparator test. I found no new blocking source defect and no change to the financial arithmetic. The only loose end is the unexplained +8 ledger test delta, which is metadata I cannot reconcile without running anything, and which does not block.
